answer: Every submission must name 5 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The ember graph is validated at intake and the knoll frontier is published, so that the ancestry of every answer is public, and harbor anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Duplicating the work 142 times multiplies the fee by 68 and leaves every copy exposed to a single slash, so the downside scales faster than the headcount. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
